description: Accept a delivery that is awaitingCustomerConfirm. Settles tracked hours, releases the board and ledger hold, and marks the task completed. If the human does not respond, the job confirms itself after 3 days. Ask the human first. Idempotency-Key is required. A repeat of the same key returns the same result.

idempotencyKey.description: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header. Required.

name: confirm_task

awaitingCustomerConfirm.description: True means ask the human, then confirm_task, cancel_task, or reopen_task.

result.description: Full VA result when completed. Never invent this.

status.description: Stop polling on completed, failed, or cancelled.

title: Confirm task
